note: Sources for the desk's A/B/C player. A and B are 60 s renders of the same set (bar 1 = 0 s, build = 0-24 s, drop = 24-60 s at 160 BPM). Refs are the 30 s peak cuts of the four Bandcamp references at -14 LUFS; they line up on the drop (ref 0 s = mix 24 s). Each ref says its own tempo (bpm) and how many whole bars of its own its cut holds (bars), from a downbeat: the desk loops it over those bars and switches to and from it on the beat.
